name: Why Square Footage Alone Doesn't Set Your Seattle Refinishing Price
title-tag: What Really Sets Refinishing Prices in Seattle, WA
meta-description: Our rate is flat — $1.99, $3.99, $6.50. So why do two 900 sq ft Seattle floors cost 37% apart? The four variables that actually move a refinishing total.
post-summary: March 29, 2027 · Our per-square-foot rate never changes, so when two same-sized Seattle houses get very different totals, something else moved. The four variables that do it — service tier, how the area was measured, stair treads, and add-ons — with two 900 sq ft floors priced side by side.
